svg.aria-label: Flowchart of the Döner Street Store Manager hiring and onboarding process, 19 numbered steps and 5 decision points across Founding Team and Admin/Payroll swimlanes. Vacancy trigger occurs; 1. confirm budget and need; 2. define screening filters; 3. post the vacancy; 4. publish a promoted LinkedIn listing (COP $150,000 budget); application window open; 5. receive applications. Admin/Payroll: 6. score CVs against the rubric; 7. verify CV accuracy; decision — CV accurate and verifiable? If no, reject the CV and keep scoring the batch. Founding Team: 8. shortlist qualified candidates; 9. first interview; decision — meets job requirements? If no, reject and return to shortlist. 10. practical assessment; decision — passes assessment? If no, reject and return to shortlist. 11. final interview; 12. select the best candidate. Admin/Payroll: 13. submit background check and verify references; decision — background check clear? If no, move to the next finalist and rerun this step. Founding Team: 14. sign employment contract ($3,500,000/mo, benefits, start date — background check already clear, so there is no separate job-offer step); decision — candidate signs? If no, contact the next finalist and return to background check for them. Admin/Payroll: 15. file candidate record. Founding Team: 16. officially hired; 17. day 1 orientation; 18. week 1 shadow shifts; 19. 30/60/90-day performance review; predefined-process — run daily production cycle, detailed in the separate 3.6.1 Production Lab flowchart; fully onboarded, independent operation begins.
